name: vr-lms-backend
description: Root manifest so Nixpacks can build all four backend services into one container. Each service keeps its own package.json and dependency tree; this only orchestrates install and start.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend/auth-service ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend/admin-service ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend/assessment-service ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend/Bastion-server ci --omit=dev

_engines_note: Node 22.x, NOT 20. @supabase/supabase-js 2.106 reaches for a native WebSocket at import time (realtime-js), which Node 20 does not provide — admin-service then throws at require of src/lib/supabaseAdmin.js, and start-all.sh takes the whole container down with it. The service Dockerfiles already pin node:22-alpine. Pinned as '22.x' rather than '>=22' on purpose: Nixpacks can satisfy an open-ended range with its own default (20), which left the crash in place even after the range was raised. .nvmrc at the repo root says 22 for the same reason — Nixpacks reads it first.
